271:t_1:4.en:
$$葵$$
「...Something inside me feels ready to explode...!」

271:t_1:5.en:
$$葵$$
「This is the wildness...! The primal instinct sleeping within humans...!」

271:t_1:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Faster, higher... stronger...! We fight to live!」

271:t_1:10.en:
$$シモン$$
(...No wind blew in underground $$ジーハ村$$...)

271:t_1:11.en:
$$シモン$$
(But ever since I came to the surface with Bro and $$ヨーコ$$, wind has always blown around me...)

271:t_1:12.en:
$$シモン$$
(It grew strong as a storm, and then... it took Bro away...)

271:t_1:13.en:
$$シモン$$
(But the wind didn't stop. It pushed me and my friends onward, and blew through $$テッペリン$$...)

271:t_1:14.en:
$$シモン$$
(Then the wind swirled and carried us all the way into space...)

271:t_1:15.en:
$$シモン$$
(The wind becomes a spiral, carrying us higher and farther...)

271:t_1:16.en:
$$シモン$$
(Through the galaxy's center... through the heavens, higher, farther... stronger...)

272:t_000:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well now... How many times have we heard that line?」

272:t_000:2.en:
$$凱$$
「Is this any time for carefree remarks!?」

272:t_000:3.en:
$$渓$$
「This place... is nothing like the space we were in before!」

272:t_000:5.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I've assessed the situation. The navigation system's position sensor points squarely to the galactic center.」

272:t_000:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh... So this is the exact center of the galaxy?」

272:t_000:8.en:
$$渓$$
「Just look at this place... It's clearly different from the space we were in!」

272:t_000:9.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「$$セイミー$$ reported from the hangar. All of $c's units have been safely recovered, at least.」

272:t_000:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...$$ＷＩＬＬ$$... Tell me your assessment of our location.」

272:t_000:11.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The natural conclusion is that the $$時空震動$$ sent us to another parallel world, but...」

272:t_000:12.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「We cannot rule out the possibility that this is the exact center of the galaxy, as the sensors indicate.」

272:t_000:14.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Conditions at the exact galactic center have never been observed.」

272:t_000:15.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「So we may now be at the exact galactic center, where no one has ever looked.」

272:t_000:16.en:
$$凱$$
「Even the all-knowing $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ has things he doesn't know...」

272:t_000:17.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Unfortunately, I am far from omniscient or omnipotent. And few across all parallel worlds likely know the exact galactic center.」

272:t_000:19.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「My research shows that the exact galactic center cannot be observed in $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ or the individual worlds that formed them.」

272:t_000:20.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The sole exception is $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$'s world. Only there has a $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest been confirmed at that point.」

272:t_000:21.en:
$$渓$$
「Then does this world have their nest, too, since it also has $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

272:t_000:22.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I don't see anything that looks like one, though...」

272:t_000:23.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s data and events so far make it clear that the galactic center lies within territory held by species hostile to humanity.」

272:t_000:24.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s activities are also very likely aimed at exterminating them.」

272:t_000:25.en:
$$渓$$
「Then they're trying to use Earth's $$次元力|lc$$ to defeat $$バアル$$...」

272:t_000:26.en:
$$田中司令$$
「If we look at that deed alone, it's admirable. They're acting to save the whole universe.」

272:t_000:29.en:
$$號$$
「$$渓$$, $$凱$$... Have you forgotten Dr. $$早乙女$$'s words?」

272:t_000:30.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...The force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life in order to erase the force that seeks to exist...」

272:t_000:31.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「That gives birth to $$バアル$$...」

272:t_000:32.en:
$$田中司令$$
「In other words, defeating $$バアル$$ would prevent the universe's rebirth... Its collapse, that is.」

272:t_000:33.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It would be like when $$ノリコ$$ and her comrades defeated the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

272:t_000:34.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, if $$バアル$$ wipes us out, what happens to the universe afterward won't really concern us.」

272:t_000:35.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ probably knows that fact and is acting on it, too.」

272:t_000:36.en:
$$渓$$
「I get what you mean, but I still can't accept them.」

272:t_000:37.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Of course. As long as they try to subjugate us through violence, they're no different from $$バアル$$.」

272:t_000:38.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Still, this has been a fruitful journey. I never imagined we'd even learn about the universe's collapse.」

272:t_000:39.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now we must work out how to take this back to Earth...」

272:t_000:40.en:
$$凱$$
「If we're at the galactic center, the distance is insane, but I thought we'd get home someday... But if this is another parallel world...」

272:t_000:43.en:
$$渓$$
「...Well... I know this isn't the time to say something like this, but...」

272:t_000:44.en:
$$渓$$
「I was thinking... how beautiful it is here...」

272:t_000:46.en:
$$田中司令$$
「You have a surprisingly girlish side, too, $$渓$$.」

272:t_000:47.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I must admit, I was thinking much the same thing myself.」

272:t_000:48.en:
$$凱$$
「...Now that you mention it, you're right...」

272:t_000:50.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Even in my travels through the galaxy, I have never seen such a beautiful sight.」

272:t_000:51.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It's a shame. Had we more time to spare, we could have savored this beauty.」

272:t_000:52.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...As if things weren't bad enough, we're apparently in further trouble.」

272:t_000:53.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I've confirmed a distortion in the dimensional boundary. Something is transferring into this space.」

272:t_001:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, hurry your sortie preparations. Until we know what's coming, we must be fully prepared to meet it.」

272:t_002:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「They're $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s! There are $$バジュラ$$, too!」

272:t_002:1.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「Those spiral-shelled creatures... They're the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ from $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s data.」

272:t_002:3.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I see no coordination between the forces, but they don't seem hostile to each other, either. Apparently we're their sole target.」

272:t_002:4.en:
$$渓$$
「They mean to intercept us for entering their territory!」
